classifying a camouflaged or partly concealed target as tiger or non-tiger.

``P_fn_close``, ``P_fn_mid`` and ``P_encounter_detection`` and the specified

validated operating envelope shall state the minimum exposed target area,
spatial resolution and target/background thermal contrast for which this

through opaque cover. When observable evidence indicates insufficient
sensing capability, the system shall issue the unavailable indication
specified by :need:`TDS_SAF_006`.

When the software detects a condition that prevents guaranteed detection
performance (startup failure, sensor loss, internal fault), it shall:

a) Transition to degraded state
b) Command the HMI to display "SYSTEM NOT OPERATIONAL" with the fault
   reason
c) Command the warning subsystem to emit a periodic acoustic alert
   (distinct from tiger alarm)

The safe state shall be reached within ``T_warning`` of fault detection.

Respond within T_warning after detection; fault detection plus response
shall remain within FTT. Degraded operation is not credited as meeting
normal detection requirements.

dst_attributes.tag_description: SOTIF residual-risk argument and scenario evidence remain open; no acceptance is claimed.

dst_attributes.note_text: Cases A, B, C1 and C2 are system-level scenario outcomes. Case C1 motivates thermal runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001; follow-up Case C2 assesses its limitation under low thermal contrast. Case A-SW contributes a classifier output insufficiency to system Case A. Case C1-SW contributes suppression of usable thermal evidence by Fusion to system Case C1 and motivates open runtime measure SOTIF_RT_002. These SW contributions are not separate independent hazardous scenarios. Validate the complete sensing, fusion, classification and warning chain, including any compensating mechanisms. Case D covers insufficient combined RGB/lidar/LWIR information with functioning sensors. It contributes to B for small targets and C2 for low thermal contrast only when complementary sensing cannot compensate. Case E covers an actual capability limitation that the intended estimator fails to recognize. D-to-E additionally requires the estimator insufficiency; the propagation graph is not an AND-gate model. Cases A/A-SW and C1-SW can occur within valid operating conditions and have no automatic propagation to E. Runtime measure SOTIF_RT_003 and validation of the D/E capability boundary and unavailable indication remain open. All three channels remain required.
Case B origin: visible sensing resolution. Healthy acquisition/FoV status is not proof that a small target can be recognized.

Case C2 assesses thermal contrast discrimination after runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 adds LWIR sensing for Case C1. LWIR blockage, calibration and contrast estimates are separate from RGB status and require independent validation.
